_readme: Roles: none < viewer < member < admin. Unlisted people get defaultRole. Edits apply on the next request; no restart needed. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

roles._note: Optional overrides. Leave out a role to keep its defaults (shown here).
roles._deepResearch: deepResearch: true lets a role use '@bot research <question>'. Only admin has it by default; add it to member to open it up.

channels._note: Optional: the most a role can do in a channel. Example: in #general, admins act as members.
